text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working developer with 6 years of experience building practical solutions in Python and machine learning. I’d be glad to help convert your PDF/AI designs into a responsive HTML5 site for desktop and mobile.

In a recent project for Marrow & Pine Grocers, I built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery. That work reduced WAPE from 31% to 19% and helped cut spoilage write-offs by 11% in pilot stores. I bring the same attention to detail, timetables, and clean execution to every project.

I’m comfortable working from provided assets and adapting existing HTML/CSS where possible, while creating styling where needed. Since you want a contractor who can deliver on time, I’d be focused on keeping the build organized and responsive.

Would you like the mobile version to closely mirror the desktop layout, or should I prioritize a simplified mobile-first presentation where needed?
